newsitem.title: GERMANY: Current German upswing to last until end 1997 - Ifo.
newsitem.headline: Current German upswing to last until end 1997 - Ifo.

text.p: Germany's Ifo institute president Karl Heinrich Oppenlaender said on Thursday that the current upturn in the German economy would last at least until the end of 1997 and possibly until mid-1998.
Speaking at the sidelines of a conference on economic issues, Oppenlaender told Reuters: "I see this lasting one-and-a-half to two years, with the starting point at mid-1996."
Oppenlaender added that Ifo was not making detailed forecasts for 1998 because of uncertainties on whether planned tax reforms could be implemented in early 1998.
Should those reforms be put in place, private consumption would certainly be given significant support, he said.
